title: Are typing games just not interesting anymore?
author: xcantene
selftext:
I've been working on a typing game for the past 4 months and honestly it's been hard to make it feel interesting and different from what's already out there.

My latest attempt was adding corruption. The game tracks your mistakes, and the more you make, the more it slowly turns from a cute fantasy game into something closer to horror. If you play well it starts to heal again. I thought this would be the thing that made it stand out, but so far it hasn't really caught on and I'm starting to wonder if people just aren't into typing games anymore.

So I'm genuinely curious. Do you still play typing games? And if you do, what would actually make one interesting to you?

If you want to see what I mean, here's the game: [https://typehunters.cloudwanderstudios.com/](https://typehunters.cloudwanderstudios.com/) (it needs a physical keyboard)

But mostly if anyone else is working on a typing game or just likes the genre, I'd really love to hear your advice. I've put a lot into this one and I want to get it right.
